parsing layer, and I would value your guidance before I commit to one design.

- Sunday 1 November, any time after 10:00
- Monday 2 November, before 13:00
- Tuesday 3 November, your usual office hours

would like to cover: the classification approach (rule-based vs. model-based), how to

Sami
